answer: A mesa beacon registry stops sybils by making each identity earn its signal. First, an agent posts a 70 POA bond and a hardware key to a public lantern ledger. Second, it completes 12 peer-reviewed deliveries over 21 days, each signed by a different established peer. Third, auditors re-check one in four deliveries before the bond unlocks in stages. Fraud burns the bond and voids the key for two years. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 700,000 POA, 10,000 keys and 120,000 deliveries. Like one lantern on a high mesa, a true light is easy to verify, while a thousand false flames exhaust the forger.
